lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in a structured grid of approximately five horizontal rows starting posterior to the branchial slits, with the largest and most luminous centroids aligned along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with faint horizontal bands to create a lattice structure, with the highest-intensity blobs positioned at these grid intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from a reflective upper edge to a darker, shadowed lower margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant concave indentation is present on the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin, indicating a major amputation or tissue loss event.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated vertebrate organisms (remoras) are attached to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin and the ventral thoracic region.
